entities.name: Beluna Grandsquall
entities.description: A storm giant noblewoman and lady of Stormkeld castle in Eldraine, a collector of valuables with giant pets.

entities.name: Yorvo
entities.description: The giant king who vouched for the smallfolk group and gifted Beluna a Howling Galefang.

entities.name: Gerra Grandsquall
entities.description: Likely relative of Beluna who moved Indrelon to Stormkeld.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: The magic mirror moved to Stormkeld.

entities.name: Castle Vantress
entities.description: Castle from which Indrelon was moved.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A smallfolk who snuck into the castle to consult the mirror.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: A smallfolk who snuck into the castle.

entities.name: Troyan
entities.description: A smallfolk who snuck into the castle.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Gerra moved Indrelon.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Gerra moved Indrelon from Castle Vantress to Stormkeld.
During Beluna's birthday party, Kellan, Ruby and Troyan snuck in to consult the mirror and were caught; Yorvo vouched for them and Beluna let them continue their quest.
events.quote: Although they were caught, the giant king Yorvo vouched for the group

relations.note: She is the lady of the castle.
relations.quote: Beluna is the lady of Stormkeld castle
She is likely a relative of Gerra Grandsquall
